function.name: SetPlan
function.description: Records discovery findings and the change plan before designing types. Keep small tasks brief.

behaviour.description: Required behaviour and how success will be checked.

existingCode.description: Relevant existing modules, types, functions and code paths found during exploration, including reusable code.

changes.description: Modules and functions to create or change, why, and integration points such as callers and UI entry points.

assumptions.description: Assumptions, unresolved questions and how the plan handles them; say none if there are none.
